summary.text: Kelly Merrick, a Republican, represents District L in the Alaska Senate; she served in the Alaska House of Representatives from 2019 to 2022 and has been a state senator since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Her legislative biography describes her as a lifelong Alaskan serving her fourth term in the Legislature.
According to that biography she sits on the Senate Finance, Labor & Commerce and Joint Armed Services committees and chairs the Senate Community & Regional Affairs Committee.
